## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Calgary, Canada. It starts at 220 St Georges Drive NE.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> TELUS Spark Science Centre entertains and inspires people of all ages through creative encounters with science, engineering, technology, math and art. With roots that go back to 1967 and the opening of the Calgary Centennial Planetarium, Spark is a leader in science entertainment, programming and science communications
>
> Get access to exciting exhibits and activities and explore one of Western Canada’s largest dome theatres and the Digital Immersion Gallery. Have a go at different VR experiences and visit the new Steven’s Lab. Meet Flint, the robot dog, and experience North America’s first robot rollercoaster, RO5IE.
>
> Kids aged 0-8 have their own special area to explore, and you can also enjoy a 15-acre park with a playground that supports brain development.
